summary.text: Lucy Boyden is a Democrat from Cambridge who has represented Lamoille-3 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
She is clerk of the House Committee on Government Operations and Military Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Boyden was born in Burlington, is a fifth-generation member of the Boyden family of Boyden Farm in Cambridge, and graduated from Lamoille Union High School, according to her House biography.
She earned a Bachelor of Science in Marketing from Roger Williams University and works as a content marketer.
Her interest in Vermont politics began as a middle school legislative page, and she later returned to the State House as a legislative intern with the Agriculture and Forestry Committee.
